Private Function Widths(ws As Worksheet) As String
    Dim s As String, c As Long
    For c = 1 To 30
        s = s & IIf(c > 1, ",", "") & ws.Columns(c).Width
    Next
    Widths = s
End Function

Private Function Fits(ws As Worksheet, scratch As Worksheet) As String
    Dim s As String, c As Long, t As String
    For c = 1 To 30
        t = ws.Cells(1, c).Text
        s = s & " " & c & "[" & t & "]"
        If t <> "" Then
            scratch.Cells(1, 1).Value = "'" & t
            scratch.Cells(1, 1).Font.Size = ws.Cells(1, c).Font.Size
            scratch.Cells(1, 1).Font.Italic = ws.Cells(1, c).Font.Italic
            scratch.Cells(1, 1).Font.Bold = False
            scratch.Columns(1).AutoFit
            s = s & scratch.Columns(1).Width
            scratch.Cells(1, 1).Font.Bold = True
            scratch.Columns(1).AutoFit
            s = s & "/" & scratch.Columns(1).Width
        End If
    Next
    Fits = s
End Function

Private Sub Act(ByVal which As Long, ws As Worksheet, r As Variant)
    Dim lo As ListObject, pt As PivotTable
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:E2"), , xlYes)
    Case 1
        Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:L2"), , xlYes)
    Case 2
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "x": ws.Range("B1").Value = "y": Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B3"), , xlYes)
    Case 3
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "a much longer header": ws.Range("B1").Value = "y": Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B3"), , xlYes)
    Case 4
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "Column1": ws.Range("B1").Value = "Column2": Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B3"), , xlYes)
    Case 5
        ws.Columns(1).ColumnWidth = 30: Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B2"), , xlYes)
    Case 6
        ws.Columns(1).ColumnWidth = 3: Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B2"), , xlYes)
    Case 7
        ws.Range("A1:B2").Value = 5: Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B2"), , xlNo)
    Case 8
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "name": ws.Range("A2:B3").Value = 1: Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B3"), , xlYes)
    Case 9
        Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B2"), , xlYes, , "TableStyleLight1")
    Case 10
        ws.Range("A1:B1").Font.Size = 20: Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B2"), , xlYes)
    Case 11
        ws.Columns(2).Hidden = True: Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:C2"), , xlYes)
    Case 12
        Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B2"), , xlGuess)
    Case 13
        ws.Range("A1:C1").Value = 5: Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:C3"), , xlNo)
    Case 14
        Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B2"), , xlYes): lo.Resize ws.Range("A1:D2")
    Case 15
        Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B2"), , xlYes): lo.ListColumns.Add
    Case 16
        Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B2"), , xlYes): lo.ShowAutoFilter = False
    Case 17
        ws.Range("A1:B2").Value = 5: Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B3"), , xlNo)
    Case 18
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "x": Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B3"), , xlYes)
    Case 19
        ws.Columns(1).ColumnWidth = 11: Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B2"), , xlYes)
    Case 20
        ws.Columns("A:AD").ColumnWidth = 0.5: ws.Range("A1:AD1").Value = Array("i", "W", "ab", "Id", "Qty", "Name", "mmmm", "Price", "iiiiiiii", "Total", "Amount", "WWWWW", "Region", "Column1", "Customer", "Quantity", "Description", "abcdefghij", "Unit price", "Order date", "llllllllllll", "Ship country", "Sales person", "MMMMMMMMMM", "Product name", "Discount rate", "Postal code 12", "xyz", "Total amount due", "Notes"): Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:AD2"), , xlYes)
    Case 21
        ws.Columns("A:AD").ColumnWidth = 0.5: ws.Range("A1:AD1").Value = Array("i", "W", "ab", "Id", "Qty", "Name", "mmmm", "Price", "iiiiiiii", "Total", "Amount", "WWWWW", "Region", "Column1", "Customer", "Quantity", "Description", "abcdefghij", "Unit price", "Order date", "llllllllllll", "Ship country", "Sales person", "MMMMMMMMMM", "Product name", "Discount rate", "Postal code 12", "xyz", "Total amount due", "Notes"): Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:AD2"), , xlYes): ws.Columns("A:AD").AutoFit
    Case 22
        ws.Range("A1:B3").Value = ws.Evaluate("{""k"",""v"";""a"",1;""b"",2}"): Set pt = ws.Parent.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:B3")).CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("D1"), "P"): pt.PivotFields("k").Orientation = xlRowField: pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("v"), "Sum of v", xlSum: r = ws.Range("D1").Text & "/" & ws.Range("D4").Text & "/" & ws.Range("E1").Text
    Case 23
        Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B2"), , xlYes, , "TableStyleLight8"): r = lo.TableStyle.TableStyleElements(xlHeaderRow).Font.Bold
    Case 24
        Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B2"), , xlYes, , ""): r = TypeName(lo.TableStyle)
    Case 25
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "x": ws.Range("A2").Value = "a long value in the data": Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:A2"), , xlYes)
    Case 26
        ws.Range("A1:B1").Font.Bold = True: Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B2"), , xlYes)
    Case 27
        ws.Range("A1:B1").Font.Italic = True: Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B2"), , xlYes)
    Case 28
        Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B2"), , xlYes, , "TableStyleMedium9"): r = lo.TableStyle.TableStyleElements(xlHeaderRow).Font.Bold
    Case 29
        ws.Range("A1:B1").Font.Size = 16: Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B2"), , xlYes)
    End Select
End Sub

Public Function Probe(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, scratch As Worksheet, r As Variant, s As String, before As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    s = "sh " & ws.StandardHeight
    before = Widths(ws)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Act which, ws, r
    s = s & "|ok"
Answered:
    On Error Resume Next
    s = s & "|" & CStr(r) & "|before " & before & "|after " & Widths(ws)
    Set scratch = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=ws)
    s = s & "|fits" & Fits(ws, scratch)
    If ws.ListObjects.Count Then s = s & "|" & ws.ListObjects(1).Range.Address & " " & ws.ListObjects(1).ShowHeaders & " " & ws.ListObjects(1).TableStyle
    s = s & "|hidden " & ws.Columns(2).Hidden & "|sh " & ws.StandardHeight
    Err.Clear
    wb.Close False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = s
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = s & "|Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Answered
End Function
